title: Updating for the First Time in a While

blocks.translation: Updating for the First Time in a While

blocks.source: 放置がとうに一年を過ぎたので、たまには更新してみます。
blocks.translation: It's been over a year since I last updated this, so I'll update it for a change.

blocks.source: ＦＦ１５は2016/11/29が発売日で、12/2にクリア。
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy XV was released on 2016/11/29, and I finished it on 12/2.

blocks.source: ＰＳ４ではネットワークを通して、他のプレイヤーのトロフィー（プレイ達成状況）を見ることができます。
blocks.translation: On the PS4, you can view other players' trophies (their gameplay achievements) over the network.

blocks.source: この時点でのエンディングトロフィーの達成率はわずか1.1％！
blocks.translation: At this point, the achievement rate for the ending trophy was just 1.1%!

blocks.source: なんで、こんなに早いかというと、もちろんニートだからです。
blocks.translation: The reason I finished it so quickly, of course, is that I'm unemployed.

blocks.source: 経済的な問題が色々と解決できたので、まったりモードなのです。次に働くのは週休３～４日がいいですね。フルタイムはもう一生やらないかもしれません。世の中を舐めてる気がしないでもないですが、気にしないでください。
blocks.translation: Now that I've resolved various financial issues, I'm taking it easy. For my next job, I'd like to work somewhere with three or four days off per week. I might never work full-time again. I may seem to be taking the world a little too lightly, but please don't worry about it.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、積んだ小説などを忙しく消化中です。ゲームは時間がかかりすぎてニートでもなかなか手が出ません。
blocks.translation: So, I'm keeping myself busy getting through the novels and other things I've accumulated. Games take too much time, so even as an unemployed person, I can hardly bring myself to play them.

blocks.source: 創作ももちろんやっていますが、まだ当分は水面下で大人しくしていると思います。
blocks.translation: Of course, I'm still working on my creative projects, but I think I'll remain quietly behind the scenes for quite some time yet.

blocks.source: 時間があれば、他のレビューなどもやりたいですね。
blocks.translation: If I have the time, I'd like to review some other things as well.

blocks.source: ちなみにＰＳ４で面白いゲームがやりたいなら、ＦＦ１５よりもまずペルソナ５をオススメします。久々にレビューしておいて台無しですが……。
blocks.translation: By the way, if you want to play an interesting game on the PS4, I recommend Persona 5 over Final Fantasy XV. Though I suppose that rather ruins the point of reviewing a game for the first time in a while...

lines.source: 何がやりたかったかというと、せっかくクリアした[[LINK_1]]ＦＦ１５のレビュー[[/LINK_1]]です。

parts.source: 何がやりたかったかというと、せっかくクリアした

lines.translation: What I wanted to do was review [[LINK_1]]FF15 Review[[/LINK_1]], which I had finally cleared.
